bio_text: Arpan Desai is a serial founder and fintech builder who co-founded MobileFirst Applications in 2014 and pivoted it into Fintegration, a specialist fintech product engineering firm with 100+ engineers serving clients across the US, UK, and India. He is also Co-Founder/CTO of SportsFirst, a sports-tech company with NFL team customers, and brings 14+ years of experience spanning mobile development, fintech API integration, AI orchestration, and enterprise consulting at PwC. Arpan is deeply embedded in the FinTech, SportsTech, and LegalTech ecosystems across India and the US.
